_format: Projects a maintainer has looked at and decided not to list.
scripts/find-candidates.js reads this file every run and subtracts it from
the search results, so anything here is never proposed again. Without it a
rejected project comes back next month and the month after, and by the
third identical report everybody has muted the issue. That is why this is
committed to the repository rather than kept in workflow state.
Each element of "declined" is an object:
url    (required) the repository or project URL, as it appeared in the
report. Matched after normalization, so http vs https, a trailing
slash, and a www. prefix are all the same entry.
reason (required) why it was declined, in a sentence. Required on
purpose: a decline with no reason cannot be revisited later, and
a run refuses to start if one is missing.
date   (conventional) ISO date of the decision, so a decline made under
old circumstances can be found and reconsidered.
To decline a candidate: copy its Repository URL out of the discovery issue,
add an object here, and commit. To un-decline one, delete its object.
